sanskrit_verse:
परिभुक्तं च यद् वासः क्लिष्टरूपं मलीमसम्
सदोषमपि विक्रीतं विक्रेतुर्न भवेत्पुनः
transliteration: paribhuktaṃ ca yad vāsaḥ kliṣṭarūpaṃ malīmasam | sadoṣam api vikrītaṃ vikretur na bhavet punaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: That which has been used, worn, defiled, or impaired in quality, even if sold, shall not again become the property of the seller.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the irreversible completion of transaction once consciousness of exchange is established
Causation follows the irreversible ontological shift upon lawful possession transfer
Capacity-based responsibility includes recognition of material condition at time of consent
Restoration logic prohibits reversal of completed exchanges unless fraud or force is proven
Consciousness alignment requires honoring the integrity of mutual consent post-factum
executable_legal_axioms: IF asset_has_been_used OR asset_is_defiled OR asset_condition_degraded THEN resale_to_original_owner IS void
IF transaction_recorded_in_consensual_ledger AND no_coercion_proven THEN reversal_capability IS null
supreme_court_application: In adjudication involving disputes over returned goods or contested resales, the threshold of responsibility lies in verifying the initial state of knowledge and consent. The court must affirm that irreversible exchange occurred under conscious agreement, thereby negating any retroactive claim by the original vendor. Authority to decide rests solely in establishing whether degradation or usage was known prior to transfer.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is based on witnessed transactional integrity; anupūrvaśaḥ confirms sequential manifestation of ownership change. Proportional responsibility aligns with awareness at moment of consent. There is no punitive consequence—only a restatement of factual ontological position: what is given cannot revert without violation of dharma.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Confirm irreversible nature of exchange through witness validation and ledger confirmation
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Affirm buyer's acceptance of item condition as part of transaction integrity
Integrity Reintegration: Ensure both parties acknowledge finality of transaction to realign consciousness around settled facts
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: This law stands immutable, rooted in Dharma, enacted for restoration, executed through consciousness, sustained beyond punishment. Reality abides in non-retrogression; justice serves only reintegration.
